axis_under_test.candidate: PatchTST-style patch embedding — groups contiguous candles into patches before projecting, shortening the effective sequence length fed downstream

comparison_scope.backbone_ref: CNN-LSTM (no-attention variant) — currently implemented baseline, see 03 § architecture candidates

baseline.name: no explicit embedding stage (zeroed) — features feed directly into local_extraction, current implemented baseline

comparison_scope.hypothesis: Grouping contiguous candles into patches before projecting to d_model (shortening the effective sequence length fed to downstream stages) improves backtested KPIs over the current zeroed-embedding baseline -- the second-highest-adjusted-score embedding candidate in 04's tiered table (adjusted 9, one point behind linear/MLP projection's adjusted 10, on the tooling modifier for lacking a mature drop-in library). Caveat, stated rather than silently ignored: 03's own rationale for this candidate is reducing attention's O(n^2) VRAM cost specifically, but this project's current Tier-1 reference backbone (CNN-LSTM, no-attention variant) has no attention stage -- so this run tests patch embedding's secondary effects only (shortened sequence into the conv/LSTM stages, patch-level local aggregation), not its primary motivating benefit. A more informative test of the attention-cost claim would pair this candidate with an attention-bearing backbone once one is promoted to reference status.

architecture.hyperparam_profile: not yet assigned S1/S2/S3 for this stage_config variant — backfill via profile_trial_cost() per 03 § architecture candidates. PatchTST-specific new hyperparams introduced by this block: patch_len and stride (patch grouping window/step over the per-tf candle sequence) — not yet default-valued or profiled; distinct from the pretrained PatchTST-based TSFM checkpoints' own patching scheme (excluded track, see 04 § Time-Series Foundation Models), this block is trained from scratch as this project's own Stage-1 candidate.
architecture.param_count_estimate: not yet computed for this stage_config; order ~0.1M-5M per 03 § hardware constraints general Stage-1 sizing note — patch embedding is a single linear projection over grouped patches, comparable or fewer params than the raw per-candle linear/MLP projection alternative since patching reduces the effective sequence length the projection operates over, negligible against that budget
